A framework that jointly optimizes triangle mesh, Physically-Based (PBR) material, and High Dynamic Range (HDR) light probe from pre-trained neural fields by combining neural field reconstruction with differentiable rasterization/ray tracing [S1, unofficial].

The claim accurately reflects the core methodology and contributions described in Source [S1]. The source explicitly states that the proposed framework (JOC) 'jointly optimizes triangle meshes, Physically-Based (PBR) materials, and High Dynamic Range (HDR) light probe' by integrating a Neural Radiance Cache (NRC) from a 'pre-trained neural field' into a ray tracing pipeline (combining neural field reconstruction with differentiable ray tracing/rasterization via DMTet). All specific components mentioned in the claim are present in the evidence.

The claim states that JOC separates indirect illumination effects from material, unlike previous methods that bake them together. Source [S1] explicitly states in the notes and the introduction passages: 'Unlike previous inverse rendering methods based on textured meshes that bake indirect illumination into materials, JOC separates indirect illumination effects from material.' This matches the claim exactly.
